title: Shadow Creature Dance
description: A large black furry creature with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth emerges from swirling blue, purple and yellow energy tendrils. A young man in dark clothing is captured mid-dance pose within the creature's swirling aura under a night sky featuring a red moon and a distant pagoda.
prompt: A large black furry monster with huge glowing white eyes and sharp teeth emerges from swirling blue purple and golden energy trails in a dark night field. A young East Asian man in dark traditional clothing is dancing dynamically inside the swirling aura. Background shows a blood red moon, a Japanese pagoda on a hill, white moon in the sky, and detailed wild plants in the foreground, dramatic fantasy scene, detailed digital painting
